arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ أَلَم تَرَ كَيفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصحٰبِ الفيلِ
transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli
translation: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant
Did He not bring their stratagem to naught
And send against them swarms of flying creatures
Which pelted them with stones of baked clay
And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)
